cards.title: Decoupled Payload Data
cards.description: Your layout is securely stored in an isolated administrative backend database, keeping your public application completely immune to common monolithic security exploits.

cards.title: Edge Routing Translation
cards.description: Zero hydration layout flashing. Our Next-Intl architecture evaluates user location requests seamlessly at the routing border layer.

cards.title: SEO Graph Blueprint Mapping
cards.description: Every layout block hooks cleanly into your Payload Admin SEO panel. Title strings, social Open-Graph preview nodes, and robots schemas are generated on the server before rendering.

heading: Absolute Control, Zero Broken Layouts
description: We engineer clear boundaries into our systems. Your content managers gain the freedom to quickly scale landing pages, while your production layout remains safe from accidental design breaks.

benefits.label: BLOCK_SPLICER

benefits.label: LOCAL_TRANSLATION

benefits.description: No complicated localized plugin systems required. Edit text strings, links, and SEO tags across multiple language views inside an integrated data block.

heading: Immutable Threat Deflection
description: Click any vector threat profile to view how our modern headless framework dynamically isolates and mitigates active vulnerabilities.

vectors.label: SQL_INJECTION_TEST
vectors.title: Data Injections
vectors.vulnerability: Monolithic relational forms accept rogue raw text queries, exposing underlying user tables.
vectors.remediation: Payload leverages parameterized query mappings and automatic structural sanitization on the server core.

logs.log: [OK] Query parameters safely bound to prepared statements.

vectors.label: DDOS_FLOOD_TRAFFIC
vectors.title: Traffic Spikes
vectors.vulnerability: High concurrency bursts saturate centralized server CPU channels, forcing site crashes.
vectors.remediation: Static routing runs directly via distributed Cloudflare Edge Workers, instantly deflecting regional spikes.

vectors.remediation: De-coupled architecture. There are no public plugin scripts running on your public server.
